title_en: Amazon Just Restocked the Elusive Pokémon TCG Prismatic Evolutions Mini Tins, but Here Is Why You Might Want to Buy Them on Elsewhere Instead
summary_en: Amazon has restocked Pokémon TCG Prismatic Evolutions Mini Tins, but TCGplayer offers cheaper prices and lets you pick your favorite Eeveelution.
body_en:
Amazon has recently restocked Pokémon TCG's Scarlet and Violet Prismatic Evolution Mini Tins . This is sold and shipped by Amazon, and not by any third-party sellers.
Stock appears to be limited, but there are still some available at the time of writing. They are currently listed for $47.99 , which is unfortunately still above market rates right now.
Compared to TCGplayer, where you can pick up any variety of these tins for around $35-$40 on average. While you may still have to take delivery into account, it's marginally still a better deal than Amazon.
Plus, you can choose which tin you want from TCGplayer , while Amazon is intent on just sending you out any of the Eeveelution-themed tins at random.
The cheapest of the tins available at TCGplayer is the Flareon tin , currently $34.88 based on current listings, and around $32.37 market rate. While the most expensive tin up for grabs is for Umbreon, at $41.97 .
So you order a tin, it arrives, but what's included? In the Prismatic Evolutions Mini Tins, you’ll find: 2 Prismatic booster packs, an Eevee coin in 1 of 8 colors, and a Pokémon art card showcasing the art from whichever tin you get.
You're meant to be able to collect and combine all eight of the available tins, but Amazon makes that a little difficult to achieve for obvious reasons.
But is it worth it? Only you can be the judge of that. The "market price" is often dictated by what the majority of people are willing to pay, but only you can decide if this if truely worth your money.
No matter how unfortunate it is, and how hard it is to find Pokémon TCG at MSRP , market value is often the price you have to pay now, even from big retailers like Amazon, as I mentioned.
Let's quickly check out the latest Pokémon TCG deals that are floating around online right now. The best, and most popular, pick right now the Pitch Black Booster Bundles for just $40 to purchase at Amazon, alongside Pitch Black ETBs for just $70 .
To see all the recently restocked items at Amazon, be sure to check out our custom search tracker to ensure you're buying sealed boosters that are only "sold and shipped" directly from Amazon itself.
Robert Anderson is IGN's Senior Commerce Editor and resident deals expert on games, collectibles, trading card games, and more. You can follow him @robertliam21 on Bluesky .
